title: CodeIntentBench rule
description: One recorded project rule. The neutral source every arm renders from.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique within the project.

statement.description: The rule in one or two plain sentences, as a product owner would write it.

rationale.description: Why the rule exists. Rendered to arms; never mentions the benchmark.

scope.description: Where the rule applies, so arms that link rules to code can do so.

tests.description: Hidden rule-test ids that encode this rule. Never shown to the agent.

kind.description: Set on rules exported from a knowledge base.

status.description: The status the knowledge base records (open, active, accepted, closed, superseded, retired, ...). Closed, superseded and retired entries no longer hold.

firmness.description: The effective firmness. firm: a person set it; ask before changing it. default: a delegated or agent choice; supersede it only on evidence. exploratory: a flagged guess.

supersedes.description: Ids of the entries this one replaces.

superseded_by.description: Ids of the entries that replace this one.
